# Adil Bhatti

> Official site of American-Pakistani author Adil Bhatti, published under Alpha Leonis Production Studio LLC. Two full-length books and ten Islamic notebooks, all sold on Amazon worldwide in paperback, hardcover, and Kindle where applicable.

## Key facts

- Author: Adil Bhatti, American-Pakistani author and independent publisher.
- Imprint: Alpha Leonis Production Studio LLC.
- Catalog: 2 books and 10 Islamic notebooks.
- Books: Omar & Ali: The Key to Orulenthia (young adult sci-fi fantasy, 243 pages, ISBN 9798218721107) and Ancient Aliens to Modern UFOs: The Disclosure Revolution (non-fiction UFO and UAP investigation, ISBN 9798218888015).
- Notebooks: 10 titles, each 200 college-ruled pages with Bismillah ar-Rahman ar-Raheem in Arabic calligraphy on every page, 6.24 x 9.24 inches, available in hardcover and paperback.
- Five hijabi-themed notebooks for Muslim women and five shawarma and halal-themed notebooks for Muslim men.
- Where to buy: Amazon worldwide; books also via IngramSpark to Barnes & Noble, Walmart, and independent bookstores.
- Pricing is shown on each Amazon product listing, not on this site.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://adilbhatti.com/): Author overview and full catalog of books and notebooks.
- [About](https://adilbhatti.com/about/): Biography of Adil Bhatti and the range of work he publishes.

## Books

- [Omar & Ali: The Key to Orulenthia](https://adilbhatti.com/books/omar-ali-key-to-orulenthia/): Young adult sci-fi fantasy about two Moroccan-American teen brothers pulled through a portal to the alien planet Orulenthia. Muslim heroes at the center. 243 pages.
- [Ancient Aliens to Modern UFOs: The Disclosure Revolution](https://adilbhatti.com/books/ancient-aliens-to-modern-ufos/): Non-fiction investigation linking ancient astronaut evidence to modern Pentagon UAP disclosure, including the 2026 PURSUE file releases.

## Notebooks for women

- [Hijabi 'til I Die](https://adilbhatti.com/notebooks/hijabi-til-i-die/): Bold hijabi notebook for Muslim women and students. Bismillah on every page.
- [Hijabi Queen](https://adilbhatti.com/notebooks/hijabi-queen/): Empowerment notebook for confident Muslim women and leaders.
- [Hijabi Gang Where My Girls At](https://adilbhatti.com/notebooks/hijabi-gang-where-my-girls-at/): Sisterhood notebook for Muslim best friends and squads, good for matching gifts.
- [Hijabi and Chill](https://adilbhatti.com/notebooks/hijabi-and-chill/): Self-care and mindfulness notebook for Muslim women.
- [Hijabi and Unbreakable](https://adilbhatti.com/notebooks/hijabi-and-unbreakable/): Resilience and sabr notebook for Muslim women going through hardship.

## Notebooks for men

- [Pray Du'a Shawarma Repeat](https://adilbhatti.com/notebooks/pray-dua-shawarma-repeat/): Witty halal-humor notebook for Muslim men and brothers.
- [That Shawarma Life](https://adilbhatti.com/notebooks/that-shawarma-life/): Lifestyle notebook for Muslim men and halal foodies.
- [It's Shawarma Time Ya Salaam](https://adilbhatti.com/notebooks/its-shawarma-time-ya-salaam/): Celebratory notebook for diaspora Muslim men and Arabic-expression lovers.
- [Halal Hustler](https://adilbhatti.com/notebooks/halal-hustler/): Notebook for ambitious, hardworking Muslim men.
- [Salah, Shawarma, Success!!](https://adilbhatti.com/notebooks/salah-shawarma-success/): Daily-wins and habit-tracking notebook for achievement-driven Muslim men.
